thread:
emily (sales): Heads-up — submitting a small ratecard format tweak for approval. Not changing list prices, just adding a new SKU for 'q-infer' (quantized optimized inference) and clarifying POC grandfathering rules. Need deal-desk + legal sign-off before I push to PROD docs.

raj (acct exec): Thanks. Can you summarize how this affects active POCs? quick yes/no is fine.

emily (sales): Short answer: most existing POCs unaffected. Two cases where action needed: (1) POCs with explicit 'ratecard version' pinned in SOW -> honor pinned terms. (2) POCs quoting with "flex commit" placeholders -> we need to decide whether to auto-map to new SKU or keep legacy SKU for billing. 

tomas (deal-desk): We should avoid auto-mapping. If the deal references the legacy SKU explicitly, we honor it. For open quotes (no SKU set) we recommend mapping to the new q-infer SKU unless customer requests otherwise. That requires a quick opt-out checkbox in the quoting UI. :white_check_mark:

mike (quoting): I can add an "Honor legacy SKU" toggle in the quoting flow. ETA: tomorrow AM. Will that cover cases?

emily (sales): yes, that should do it. We also need a short legal clause for the grandfathering policy (1-yr grace for active POCs) so CS/ops can enforce. cc @dena (legal).

dena (legal): Need to see the exact wording users will see and the billing mapping doc. Proposed guardrails: "If a POC explicitly references a ratecard version, those terms prevail. For POCs without a version, Redwood may assign functionally equivalent SKUs; customers will be notified 30 days prior." We want to avoid open-ended language.

emily (sales): Draft wording below — please edit: 

```
Grandfathering policy (draft):
- Active POCs that reference a specific ratecard version in the SOW will be billed under that version until the SOW expires or is amended.
- Active POCs without a pinned ratecard version will be mapped to the closest functional SKU. Customers will receive notice 30 days before mapping, with the option to request legacy billing for the POC for up to 12 months from mapping.
```

dena (legal): Looks good. Change "closest functional SKU" -> "functionally equivalent SKU". Also add: "Redwood may refuse grandfathering if it materially impacts resource allocation or violates compliance requirements."

emily (sales): updated. Thanks.

tomas (deal-desk): From ops side, we need to ensure internal ratecard versioning metadata is included in the quote JSON. Minimal fields: ratecard_version, sku_code, mapped_from_version (optional). Example: 

```json
{
  "ratecard_version": "v2026-07",
  "sku_code": "QINF-XS",
  "mapped_from_version": "v2025-11"
}
```

mike (quoting): Ok I'll wire those fields into the API. Any objections to SKU code pattern QINF-<tier>?

raj (acct exec): Fine by me. One ask: for APAC customers, will there be any regional surcharge for q-infer? last time we saw GPU price deltas.

emily (sales): Good point. Ratecard change includes a regional multiplier note (APAC +4% on GPU-backed SKUs). It's informational only — not a separate SKU. We should call it out in quotes for transparency.

tomas (deal-desk): Approval path: deal-desk + legal sign-off, then product ops to publish v2026-07 to docs. I'm marking this as "minor format update" so no exec approval required.

ops-bot: New draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/ratecards/v2026-07/draft (comments open) :page_with_curl:

emily (sales): Perfect. Quick checklist before I flip to public: 
- [ ] legal approved text (dena)
- [ ] deal-desk mapping rules (tomas)
- [ ] quoting UI toggle (mike)
- [ ] notify active POC owners (sales)

dena (legal): Approved with edits (functionally equivalent SKU + refusal clause).

mike (quoting): Toggle done and API fields wired. Deployed to staging. 

tomas (deal-desk): Mapping rules documented in ops runbook. I added examples and edge cases (SOW ambiguous, change requests).

emily (sales): Thanks all. I'll run a one-line slack announcement when we publish and ping the POC owners list. If anyone wants the final diff, here's the core change (not prices): 

```diff
- SKU list: INF-XS, INF-S, INF-M
+ SKU list: INF-XS, INF-S, INF-M, QINF-XS (quantized optimized inference)
+ Note: APAC multiplier +4% for GPU-backed SKUs
+ Policy: explicit ratecard version in SOW -> honor pinned terms; unpinned POCs -> map to functionally equivalent SKU with 30-day notice and 12-month opt-out
```

raj (acct exec): Looks solid. Please tag me for any POCs in APAC.

emily (sales): Will do. Publishing today after ops confirms staging smoke tests. :rocket:

mike (quoting): Staging smoke green. No regressions.

tomas (deal-desk): Approved to publish. I'll update the internal change log.

emily (sales): Publishing now. Announcement will go out in #sales and #customer-success. Thanks team! :tada:
